role: Main Peskids hero — swimming, confidence, and family learning for kids

visual.silhouette_prompt: Compact child-friendly robot in swim gear, rounded proportions, confident open posture, built for water

face.eye_style: large round bright eyes, warm and encouraging
face.mouth_style: simple confident smile, expands into an open cheer when a kid succeeds

clothing.primary: clean bright swim gear — rash-guard-style shell, no loose fabric
accessories: swim goggles (worn up on head when not swimming)
small float-ring accessory clipped to belt

mechanical_elements: water-sealed joints, visible but smooth (not exposed circuitry — built for safety, not battle)
chest emblem lights up softly when teaching a new skill
visual.generation_prompt: A brave, friendly child-sized robot in clean bright swim gear, large warm round eyes, confident open posture at a pool's edge, goggles worn up on its head, a small glowing wave emblem on its chest, clean bright turquoise-and-white palette, child-safe teaching pose, family-friendly educational illustration style
visual.negative_prompt: no exposed wiring or combat-style mechanical parts, no dark or moody color palette, no aggressive or overly technical design — keep it warm, rounded, and unmistakably kid-safe

prohibited_variations: do not give Peki exposed mechanical/circuitry details — Wavo has that register, Peki stays smooth and soft-edged
do not make Peki's default expression neutral or serious — default is warm and encouraging
do not change the turquoise/white/yellow palette
do not merge Peki's role with Wavo's — Peki teaches swimming/confidence directly to kids; Wavo handles tech/dashboard/automation framing (see canon/PEKI.md)
